items.title: 5 Dividend Stocks With Ex-Dividend Deadlines This Week. The First Is Today
items.summary: One utility's payout window slams shut at today's closing bell, and four more follow before Friday. Each dividend carries a hidden catch, from heavy debt to a payout frozen since 2020, so the yield alone won't tell you which are safe.

items.title: NRG Energy Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: NRG Energy (NYSE:NRG) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, November 9, 2026. The company has a market value of about $17.0 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $33.1 billion in revenue and $2.1 billion in operating profit, with net income of $849 million.

items.title: Google Is Spending $17 Billion on a Wyoming Data Center and Says It Will Pay for 100% of Its Power
items.summary: Google just answered the loudest objection to AI data centers, yet the market barely noticed and one key supplier tumbled. The fine print on who supplies the power, and what the pledge leaves out, may matter more than the headline.
